1.

On God’s Lamb our faith now rests, Without limit His love is. All our sins have been In His blood washed away here.

2.

Sweet rest and peace have filled us, Praise that cannot be uttered. God is satisfied with Jesus, And we rejoice as He does.

3.

Conscience no longer condemns us, For His own precious blood Has cleansed, washed us, and set us Before God with holy boldness.

4.

Ever filled with His peace We go forward despite toils here, Until an eternal rest surrounds us In the Lamb’s dwelling there.
